The feeder identifier is a location-based technical identifier that can be mapped to a specific geographic area and its consumers. Combined with grid topology data, it can be used to identify a specific group of households and businesses, enabling tracking of their consumption patterns. The substation identifier, like the feeder, is a location-based identifier that pinpoints a specific electrical infrastructure node serving a defined geographic area. It can be cross-referenced with public grid maps to identify the exact service area and its residents, making it a location identifier that can lead to group-level re-identification.
